text:
Maya Singh: AetherBio asks for an unusual billing plan: milestone invoicing tied to integration milestones (30/30/40) for a 12mo Dedicated commit, plus a one-time 10% "onboard" discount applied to the first milestone. They also want invoices split across two legal entities and to defer recognition to their parent entity.
Tom Ruiz: What's the commit size?
Maya Singh: 85k/mo reserved, ARR ~ $1.02M. They say VAT and local banking requires splitting invoices. They also want termination fee waived for the first 90 days.
Erin (RevOps): Milestone billing + split invoicing + waived term fees is non-standard. Need Deal Desk + Legal (entity split) + Finance (revenue recognition).
CFO Bot: Flag: revenue recognition risk if invoicing to a third party. Need signed assignment and PO from billed entities. Consider requiring an A/R guarantee or bank guarantee.
Tom Ruiz: Credit risk high. Recommend conditional approval: accept milestone invoicing if (1) both entities sign the SOW, (2) a parent entity guarantee or letter of credit for first 3 months, and (3) onboarding discount capped at $8k. Also require standard termination fees remain in place after day 90.
Erin (RevOps): Draft summary for Deal Desk: 
```
Deal: AetherBio
Commit: 85k/mo reserved (12mo)
Concessions requested: 10% onboard discount on milestone 1 + milestone invoicing 30/30/40 + invoice split across two entities + waive termination fee first 90 days
Finance conditions: parent guarantee or LOC for first 90 days; cap onboard credit at $8k; both billed entities must sign SOW or provide PO; reinstatement of termination fees after 90 days
Legal: add assignment clause and confirmation of tax/VAT handling
```
Maya Singh: tagging Legal and Sales to get dual signatures: @LegalBot @Lina (AE)
LegalBot: Quick read — Invoice splitting ok with signed intercompany agreement and tax clause. Recommend escrow for the 3rd milestone until integration signoff. Also need to preserve indemnity and termination language.
Tom Ruiz: I'll approve finance side once we have parent guarantee/LOC or an acceptable bank guarantee and SOWs from both entities uploaded. Also logging DD-5010.
Erin (RevOps): I'll enter DD-5010 into Deal Desk and mark as pending bank guarantee + signed SOWs.
Lina (AE): I'll push for signatures and start the LOC conversation with their treasury.
Maya Singh: Thanks — will follow up.
RevenueOps Bot: DD-5010 created. Status: pending documents.
Maya Singh: (later) Uploaded draft SOWs from both entities and initial LOC term sheet. Pinging finance for re-review.
Tom Ruiz: Received docs. Banking docs look OK but need legal to confirm the LOC wording.
LegalBot: LOC draft acceptable; will insert standard invoice assignment and escrow trigger for milestone 3. Once done, finance can finalize approval.
Tom Ruiz: Approving finance side now per conditions. Marking concession approved in Deal Desk. :white_check_mark:
Maya Singh: Great — I'll finalize contract addendum and get signatures. Thanks team. :tada:
